sentences.en: He remained grave and thoughtful while they resumed their journey.
sentences.zh: 他们继续旅程时，他保持严肃且深思的样子。

sentences.en: It's thoughtful of you to remind me of my promise.
sentences.zh: 你提醒我遵守诺言真是体贴。

sentences.en: You were thoughtful to remember me in this way.
sentences.zh: 你以这种方式记挂着我真贴心。

senses.zh: 体贴的，关心他人的；深思熟虑的，考虑周到的；沉思的，陷入沉思的；若有所思的
